claude-opus-5-5.note: A clean, fleecy camelid with a long neck, small head and upright ears, though the very tall neck, banana ears and spindly legs read slightly llama-like; legs swap lift and plant phases plausibly across frames while the foreground scrolls for parallax, all set in a polished but fairly generic mountai

openai-gpt-6-sol.note: The alpaca is recognizable and the scene is polished, but the leg movement is stiff and the last two poses are nearly identical.
